conviction_note: Yuanbao's whole equity story is '15 consecutive quarters of operating leverage in marketing expenses'; Q2 is structurally its worst marketing-cost quarter (S&M was 56.3% of revenue in Q2 2025 vs 48.5% in Q1 2026) and its direct listed competitor just disclosed, two days ago, that it quintupled third-party traffic-channel spend into the same public-domain auction pool during exactly this quarter and intends to keep doing so — so I size a margin-driven negative reaction at roughly half the 10.1% historical median move, cushioned by an accelerating addressable market and a balance sheet close to the market cap.

findings.finding: Waterdrop (WDH), the closest listed comparable, reported on 2026-09-08 that Q2 2026 sales and marketing expense went from RMB199m to RMB637.5m (+220.7% YoY) driven by a ~RMB415-450m increase in third-party traffic-channel spend, and told the call it will 'maintain an active user acquisition pace' through H2 2026 and FY2027 — an incremental bid roughly two-thirds the size of Yuanbao's entire quarterly marketing budget (RMB638.2m in Q1 2026) landing in the same public-domain traffic auctions during the exact quarter Yuanbao is about to report.
findings.why_not_priced: Waterdrop printed on 2026-09-08 and its ADS rose over 10% pre-market on the revenue line; Yuanbao's baseline shows 5-day run-up of -1.98% and 20-day of -2.69%, i.e. the tape did not move Yuanbao at all on its comparable's result. If the market had read across, YB would have moved in the two sessions since 09-08 in one direction or the other, and there would be at least one English-language note tying WDH's traffic-cost line to YB's cost structure — there is none. No option chain exists, so there is no skew that could already carry this.
findings.independence: Confirmed from a second, independent transcript source that quantifies the same line and adds the H2 intent: https://www.aol.com/articles/waterdrop-wdh-q2-2026-earnings-002823000.html (2026-09-08) — 'active step up in public domain traffic investment... third party traffic channels increasing by about 450 million', 'nearly 638 million compared with 199 million'. Also corroborated in Chinese by https://cn.investing.com/news/transcripts/article-93CH-3556246 (WDH operating profit only +14.3% YoY on +72.8% revenue). Note this is the same underlying WDH release read from three outlets — one source cluster, not three.

findings.finding: Q2 is Yuanbao's structural margin trough and its only negative print: selling and marketing expense was RMB602.1m on RMB1,069.9m of revenue in Q2 2025 (56.3% of revenue) against 49.2% in Q3 2025, 47.0% in Q4 2025 and 48.5% in Q1 2026, and the 2025-08-28 Q2 print sent the stock -11.46% even though net income rose 55.6% YoY that quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Yuanbao has no option chain, no visible sell-side consensus and roughly $300k of daily turnover, so there is no mechanism that would have marked the seasonal cost step into the price. The anchor a reader carries into this print is the Q1 2026 release: 29.5% net margin, +35.6% revenue, a US$1.26/ADS dividend and a +15.6% reaction. If the Q2 seasonal cost pattern were priced, the 20-day run-up would be negative rather than the -2.69% of noise the baseline records, and the reaction history would not show a -11.46% surprise on the last Q2.
findings.independence: Different document from finding 1 and a different company, but the same thesis (Q2 2026 margin compression). The quarterly S&M ratio series is built from four separate Yuanbao releases: Q1 2026 RMB638.2m/RMB1,315.9m at https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/10/3309527/0/en/yuanbao-inc-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results.html (2026-06-10) and Q3/Q4 2025 at https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/12/03/3198645/0/en/Yuanbao-Inc-Announces-Third-Quarter-2025-Unaudited-Financial-Results.html (2025-12-03). Management itself flagged the risk on the Q1 2026 call, claiming '15 consecutive quarters' of marketing operating leverage 'despite industry-wide rising acquisition costs' (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/06/11/yuanbao-yb-q1-2026-earnings-call-transcript/).

findings.finding: China's eight-ministry 《金融产品网络营销管理办法》 was issued 2026-04-24 and takes effect 2026-09-30 — twenty days after this print — requiring that third-party internet platforms providing a purchase hand-off jump only to the financial institution's own platform, barring unlicensed or disguised online marketing of financial products, and regulating algorithmic recommendation and livestream selling, with an explicit pre-effective-date rectification obligation that falls inside Q3 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no English-language coverage connecting this rule to Yuanbao, whose entire funnel is paid public-domain traffic converted through algorithmic and short-video placements. Management's only public comment was on 2026-06-11 that the April rules had 'no material impact' — but that statement was made three and a half months before the compliance date and before the cleanup window. If this were priced there would be a visible de-rating step around 2026-04-24 or a September drift ahead of the effective date, not the flat -2.69% 20-day tape the baseline shows.
findings.independence: Independent secondary confirmation of the effective date and the insurance-specific scope: https://m.jrj.com.cn/madapter/insurance/2026/04/24180856880786.shtml (2026-04-24, jrj.com.cn). Weak same-direction corroboration on Yuanbao's compliance surface from Chinese consumer reporting citing 1,217 Black Cat complaints and a Gansu Consumer Association naming over unauthorised auto-deduction: https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260320A001OR00 (2026-03-20) — that one is six months old and I treat it as stale.

findings.finding: NFRA H1 2026 data show the segment Yuanbao actually sits in is accelerating while the rest of health insurance is not: P&C insurers' health premiums (short-term medical, inclusive health, city-customised — Yuanbao's 百万医疗险 product set) grew 15.29% to RMB185.5bn, against life insurers' health premiums at -0.67%, with total health premiums of RMB643.8bn up only 3.45%.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline number every wire carries is the +3.45% (or the all-industry +3.25%) total, which reads as a stalling market; the 15.29% sub-line for the P&C-written short-term medical business Yuanbao distributes is buried in the split and has no English coverage. Combined with Waterdrop's insurance income +80.5% YoY on 2026-09-08, the demand backdrop is visibly stronger than the headline — and Yuanbao's price has not moved for it in either direction over the last five sessions.
findings.independence: Separate document and separate publisher from every other finding here. Same-direction on demand from the Waterdrop release cluster (insurance-related income RMB1,333.2m, +80.5% YoY, https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/waterdrop-inc-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-and-a-cash-dividend-302872033.html) — I flag that overlap explicitly, since that cluster is also the basis of finding 1 read in the opposite direction; the demand line and the cost line are genuinely different numbers in the same release.

searched_and_found_nothing: SEC EDGAR full filing list for CIK 0001995520 — only five 6-Ks exist, all earnings releases (2025-06-06, 2025-08-28, 2025-12-03, 2026-03-18, 2026-06-10). No quiet 8-K/6-K, no shelf, no follow-on, no 20-F surprise, and as a foreign private issuer there are no Form 4s to cluster.
Any disclosure of buyback execution under the US$15m authorisation announced 2026-06-10 — nothing filed, so the size of any company bid in a ~$300k-a-day stock is unknowable.
NFRA and Beijing bureau administrative-penalty databases for a 2026 enforcement action against 元保保险经纪(北京)有限公司 — nothing found in 2026; the only located penalty is a 2022 Shaanxi fine of RMB10,000.

Yuanbao-specific Chinese media for August or September 2026 — nothing beyond a 2026-07-24 corporate PR piece on claims-handling speed. The critical 'targets the elderly' coverage is dated 2026-03-20 and predates two prints.
Any sell-side preview, consensus estimate, price target or English-language write-up connecting Waterdrop's 2026-09-08 print to Yuanbao — none found; coverage appears to be effectively zero.
A short-interest, borrow or option-skew read — the baseline records no options market and I found no usable short-interest datum.
Hiring-page, app-store-review-volume and status-page angles — Yuanbao's funnel is a WeChat/Douyin ad-to-mini-program flow with no meaningful US app-store surface to sample.
ZhongAn Online H1 2026 as an insurer-partner read-across — I could not verify the H1 2026 GWP figures from a URL whose path confirmed the year, so I dropped it rather than date a 2025 story as 2026.
baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with and the 20-day run-up is flat at -2.69%, so nothing directional is priced; my read cuts against the most recent anchor the market has — Q1 2026's +35.6% revenue, 29.5% net margin and +15.6% reaction — but it is deliberately held to roughly half the 10.1% median historical move because the demand backdrop is genuinely strong and the company's ~RMB4.74bn (US$687m) liquidity sits close to its entire market capitalisation, which caps how far a margin disappointment can push a stock that four of its last five prints sent higher.
